top_signals.title: How China and America Can Move from Competition to Stability
top_signals.summary:
The American team thought it was signaling restraint. The Chinese team saw preparations for combat. In a closed-door Sino-American crisis simulation I helped organize in the 2010s — which the U.S. military funded as part of a long-term project — the Americans repositioned an aircraft carrier away from a maritime dispute between China and the Philippines, expecting the move to reassure Beijing. Instead, the Chinese participants became deeply alarmed. They believed the carrier was now ideally positioned to launch combat operations while remaining less vulnerable to attack. top_signals.title: CREA: India Curtailed Over 4% of Its Solar Output in July and August
top_signals.summary: India’s record renewable power generation and solar output were overshadowed by curtailments in July and August when India experienced power availability shortages. Over 4% of the solar power generated in July and August had to be curtailed because of grid and operational constraints, the Finland-based Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA) said in a report on Monday.
